name: Survey tile in Aries
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.7 degrees south of the ecliptic in Aries, imaged by SPHEREx 25 times in 7 visits over 77 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 47 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 3.2 days starting 2025-07-24, at wavelengths from 0.75 to 4.95 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
